en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a formal urban garden or square with paths radiating around a central fountain and statue, bordered by multi‑story neoclassical and early 20th‑century buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk through the park. Greek text appears at the lower left and French text at the lower right; a website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is overprinted across the image.
